about: Both rules of the elevation ladder are held across the app as of 2026-09-17 (phase 7c of docs/ui-system-refinement.md), so the two lists below are empty and a new violation fails the test outright. `exempt` is the other thing: a rule that breaks a rule and is right to, with the reason written out. An exempt entry is counted nowhere and must still apply — one matching no violating rule fails, so a converted rule cannot leave its reason behind. If a list has to grow again, say why in the change that grows it.

exempt.src/gear/gear.css|.gear-auth-copy::after: The dev-only Gear screen sign-in halo: two 55px rings of 4% accent drawn as a shadow. It is a light source behind the copy, not an edge round a box.
exempt.src/styles.css|.training-recovery-ring::: The recovery ring itself. The ring is the datum and the glow is its colour; neither is elevation.
exempt.src/styles.css|.watchface-studio-preview: A watch, drawn: the 9px border is the case, the 2px ring the bezel and the drop shadow the watch sitting on the page.
exempt.src/watchfaces/watchfaces.css|:is(.watch: The same watch, scoped to the studio shell.
exempt.src/watchfaces/watchfaces.css|.watchface: A stack of face previews, each an image of a watch on its strap.
Gallery faces on the sign-in screen: images of watches, not cards.
